name: 8162-lorachurn-8blora-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1, ep1. Single-GPU is part of the declaration; no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, bf16: 32 layers, GQA with 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, ~16.1 GB of weights on one card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 16 streams, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 400 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 256 prompt / 256 output tokens fixed, seed 42, `ignore_eos`, radix cache off. Beside the traffic a background loop cycles three further LoRA adapters round-robin -- load, sleep 1 s, unload, sleep 1 s -- declared as `side_channel` in scenario.json; none of the three is ever requested, and the 1 s sleeps set the duty cycle.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant on one GPU answering sixteen concurrent short requests while personalization adapters rotate in the background.
launch:
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# Requests reach this adapter through the non-OpenAI `lora_path` body field in scenario.json;
# naming it in `model` does nothing, and without the field the server answers from the base model.
enable-lora: true
lora-paths: ["lora=algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora"]
max-loras-per-batch: 1

# Sizes the pool for the union of supported projections; inferred sizing from the resident
# adapter alone refuses two of the three adapters the side channel brings in.
max-lora-rank: 256
lora-target-modules: ["all"]

disable-radix-cache: true

mem-fraction-static: 0.8
random-seed: 42
